findings.title: Timestamp-only measurement restamp
findings.detail: Commit only rewrites run timestamps (dark 07:30:35Z → 08:29:52Z; light 07:30:39Z → 08:29:56Z). No application code, tests, or axe report bodies appear in the diff. Updating `at` while leaving the same report paths and `ok: true` is not proof that measurements were re-run; the new times are unverifiable from this diff alone.

findings.title: Referenced axe reports not in diff
findings.detail: Meta still points at evidence/axe/az-planting-calendar-dark.json and evidence/axe/az-planting-calendar-light.json, but those report files are unchanged in this commit. Cannot verify axe results, violation counts, or that the stamped runs match real report content.

findings.title: No substantive product change to judge
findings.detail: Entire unified diff is a 12-line hunk in measurement-meta.json only. Nothing about UI, API routes, brand, SOURCES/INTEGRATIONS/COMPETITORS, routes, or screenshots can be verified as fixed or present from this commit. Any claim that the app improved at 1ec2bf0 fails for lack of evidence in the diff.
